900.3.10(197).explanation: Exception RD 197 sets a 0.9 m minimum side yard setback and a 2.4 m minimum setback from a street side lot line, requires compliance with exception 1462, and at 2955 Kingston Road permits office, medical office, clinic and a dwelling unit within a small mixed use building with its own landscaping and parking rules. Schedule "C" Exception 12 of former Scarborough by-law 9396 also prevails.

900.3.10(267).explanation: Exception RD 267 sets a 9.0 m minimum setback from the front lot line, 0.9 m from a side lot line, 2.4 m from a street side lot line and 0.3 m for a garage from an interior side lot line, and requires compliance with exception 1462. Performance Standard 1 of the Agincourt Community By-law 10076 is listed as prevailing.

900.3.10(98).explanation: Exception RD 98 fixes the minimum lot frontage and lot area at what existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, requires a 22.0 m setback from the original centreline of Scarborough Golf Club Rd., a 1.2 m side setback, a 3.6 m street side setback and 0.3 m for a garage from a side lot line. No prevailing by-laws apply.
